The full FR-024 loader contract now holds: object.projection registration + per-subtype projection child rules + dotted Entity.child extends-resolution (type-scoped, ERR_EXTENDS_TARGET_MISMATCH), AND the validation passes — identity names required + projection identity pass-through/key-correspondence (B3), value-purity + projection-licensing subtype rules (B4a), the entity-primary-source-readonly hard cutover (B4b), @via single-hop-unique inference + origin cardinality (B5), and extends/origin agreement + derived-field providability (B6).
